newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbek GDP rises 1.5 pct in Jan-Sept year-on-year. [CORRECTED 11:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Uzbek GDP rises 1.5 pct in Jan-Sept year-on-year. [CORRECTED 11:49 GMT]

text.p: Uzbekistan's gross domestic product in the first nine months of this year totalled 350.5 billion sums (corrects by adding dropped word billion), a rise of 1.5 percent over the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Friday.
The committee had previously said that GDP rose 0.3 percent in January-September 1995.
